info.name: Payload middleware — inquiries
info.description:
Test toka WordPress inquiry → processInquiry job → Excel ponuda sa DK cenama.

Pre prvog pokretanja popuni varijable kolekcije: webhookSecret (WEBHOOK_SECRET iz .env), adminEmail, adminPassword.

Redosled: 1 → 2 → sačekaj ~1 min (job radi jednom u minuti) → 3 → 4 (Send and Download) → 5.

exec: // Potpisuje sirovi body kao WordPress: hash_hmac('sha256', $body, WEBHOOK_SECRET) -> X-Signature
if (!secret) throw new Error('Popuni varijablu kolekcije webhookSecret (WEBHOOK_SECRET iz .env)');
console.log('inquiryId =', j.id, '— sačekaj ~1 min pa pokreni korak 3');
console.log('status:', j.status, '| proizvod:', wp.itemCode, wp.resolvedDescription, '| cena (sa PDV):', wp.resolvedUnitPrice);

request.description: Klikni strelicu pored Send → Send and Download da sačuvaš .xlsx. Otvori ga u Excel-u/Numbers-u da se VLOOKUP formule preračunaju.

item.name: 5. Catalog prices for the test items

exec: console.table((j.docs || []).map(d => ({ itemCode: d.itemCode, description: d.description, cenaSaPDV: d.unitPrice1WithTax })));

request.description: Uporedi ove cene sa listom Vörulisti u skinutom .xlsx fajlu (H101, BK101, LK01, FK01).

item.name: 6. Accept inquiry (opciono — refresh DK cena + nova ponuda)

request.description: Isto kao dugme Accept u adminu: povlači žive DK cene, generiše novu ponudu, status → accepted. Ponovni accept vraća 409.
